hypotheses.F1_fisher_selection_improves_discovery_o: At rank eight, Fisher-greedy selection reduces discovery Fisher score error by at least 20% relative to the Frobenius prefix.
hypotheses.F2_fisher_rank8_improves_exact_kl: At rank eight, Fisher selection reduces median exact final-distribution KL by at least 20% relative to the Frobenius prefix on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.F3_fisher_rank16_reaches_behavioral_gate: The Fisher-selected rank-16 program has median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.F4_fisher_selection_beats_mse_selection: At rank eight, Fisher selection has lower median exact KL than score-MSE selection on every corpus.
hypotheses.F5_fisher_selection_is_nontrivial: At least two Fisher-selected rank-eight axes lie outside the Frobenius top eight.
hypotheses.F6_fisher_selection_beats_random_subsets: The Fisher-selected rank-eight discovery objective beats all 64 random rank-eight subsets from the same candidate pool.
